publication_review_annotations.purpose: Documentation only; records the operator publication decision and source evidence status without altering reviewed CSVs or immutable evidence. Actual admission is enforced by runtime source gates and statistical projection rules.

reuse_permission.meaning: Verifiable permission to reuse and publicly redistribute the actual source data; not account access, download credentials, or an API key.
reuse_permission.acceptable_evidence: An applicable official open license for the exact resource, or a verifiable rights-holder grant covering the ingested data and intended uses. Separate written consent is not required when an applicable open license already supplies permission.
reuse_permission.scope_to_verify: Source/resource identity, versions, years and geography; extraction, charts, downloads and applicable API/mirror distribution; attribution, license links, change notices, share-alike conditions and third-party exceptions.
reuse_permission.evidence_to_record: Publisher/rights holder, source and license URLs, license version, capture date, archived response or grant and SHA-256, required attribution and applicable conditions.
reuse_permission.pending_is_not_prohibited: Missing evidence is pending review, not a finding that reuse is forbidden. Public accessibility or a license for another dataset does not establish a grant for this source.
reuse_permission.after_evidence: Continue source evidence work without blocking this operator-authorized release; update attribution and actual applicable terms when evidence is established, and retain publication acceptance for data correctness.

AR.reason: Weekly BEN cumulative snapshots are not single-week incident counts. Notification, clinical and laboratory definitions remain separate.
AR.required_to_clear: Review source-reported weekly counts or an explicit cumulative differencing contract covering compatible definitions, geography, cutoff calendar, year resets, missing weeks and retrospective revisions. Any native cumulative display requires separate acceptance.
AR.rights_note: Government-owned content defaults to CC BY 4.0 subject to declared and third-party exceptions; this does not resolve the statistical blocker.
AR.current_decision: Retain reviewed concept mappings with no_projection.
AR.country_publication_status: Only the independent Ministry HIV annual source is now ingested and admitted; this statistical blocker applies to SRC_AR_BEN, whose existing no_projection mappings remain unchanged.

CO.reason: Municipality-of-occurrence event/week records have no verified national aggregation contract or official dated week boundaries. Synthetic storage dates are sorting anchors only.
CO.required_to_clear: Verify geography and coverage, non-overlap and deduplication, unknown/foreign/missing-location treatment, revisions and official source-year week boundaries; independently validate any national aggregation.
CO.rights_note: Historical dataset 4hyg-wa9d declares CC BY-SA 4.0; separate successor wns8-p38i declares CC BY 4.0. Neither license resolves geography or calendar semantics.
CO.current_decision: Retain source municipality facts and reviewed concept mappings with no_projection.
